states.changed: The work opens: one papyrus at a time, read from what survives on the sherd up to the clean text, with the 677-document draw and its unfilled losses below.

A fifth state, the training pair, shows what an open corpus gives a restoration model (the editor's expansions in the scribe's ink, lost and doubtful letters as dashes), and a new section shows what three paths do to the marks, with the four predictions fixed before looking and their verdicts.
